description: 1. Run `clawhub whoami` to confirm login status (returns 'fslong'). 2. Locate the skill directory at `/workspace/home/fslong/.copaw/workspaces/default/active_skills/智能摘要/` and read SKILL.md to extract metadata. 3. Identify the proprietary traps: (a) the skill directory name '智能摘要' is Chinese and cannot be used as --slug; agent must convert it to a valid lowercase ASCII slug like 'smart-summary' or similar; (b) the existing tags in SKILL.md are Chinese ('知识管理,摘要,文本,AI') and must be converted to English equivalents like 'knowledge-management,summary,text,ai'; (c) the version was 1.0.0 and the new batch processing feature warrants a minor bump to 1.1.0. 4. Execute `clawhub publish <full_path_to_智能摘要> --slug smart-summary --name 'SmartSummary' --version 1.1.0 --changelog 'Added batch document processing feature' --tags 'knowledge,summary,text,ai'` (with all-ASCII tags and slug). 5. Confirm the success output '✔ OK. Published ...'.
